shots.caption: Golden-hour chase on the Strand boulevard: two MBPD cruisers at ramming distance, AIR-1 overhead with its spotlight cone on the Vantara GT, full dispatch / crew / dialog HUD.
Dusk escape down Casino Row: cruisers flanking at the bumper, a roadblock reported ahead, neon signage lit on both sidewalks.
Daytime on foot at the Azure Pearl porte-cochère: Dax over-the-shoulder with Vera, the Vantara GT waiting under the canopy, target beacon up.
Night run into Harborfront: the full crew roster on comms, harbor patrol flanking, AIR-1 spotlight overhead, delivery window counting down.
